title: Factors that May Impede Adoption of Electric Vehicles
what_it_is: Factors that May Impede Adoption of Electric Vehicles

sections.label: EV adoption in Singapore
sections.summary: Electric car registrations in 2022 exceeded 10% of new car registrations, almost triple last year's rate, with government support through tax rebates and charging points.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Despite cost pressures on vehicles in recent times, such as supply chain issues and higher interest rates, Electric Vehicle (EV) adoption in Singapore has grown strongly this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: For example, electric car registrations in 2022 so far, have exceeded 10% of all new car registrations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: That is almost triple the rate last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The Government also continues to support EV adoption by providing tax rebates, accelerating the deployment of EV charging points and strengthening regulations to ensure the safety and reliability of our EV charging network.
